newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Malaysia Air to buy stake from Evergreen unit.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Air to buy stake from Evergreen unit.

text.p: Malaysia Airline System planned to buy stake from Taiwan's Evergreen Sky Catering, a unit of the Evergreen group, EVA officials said on Wednesday.

"Evergreen Sky has been negotiating the deal with Malaysia Airlines and the two are about to reach an agreement on the planned purchase," a spokesman of the EVA Airways, an affiliate of the Evergreen group, told Reuters by telephone.
He declined to disclose how many shares Malaysia Airlines planned to buy.
Taiwan's Commercial Times newspaper reported that Malaysian Airlines was expected to buy a 10-percent ownership, or T$100 million, from Evergreen Sky Catering.
Evergreen Sky is expected to provide food to passengers aboard Malaysia and Singapore Airlines, which owns 15 percent of the catering company.
Singapore Airlines acquired 15 percent of Evergreen Sky when Evergreen Sky was established in 1996 by the Evergreen group with a total net asset of T$1 billion, officials said.
